TypeScript · Three.js
Web Workers · PWA

Procedural · Deterministic

A planet from a seed you can fly over.

Every world is a pure function of its seed, so a link is the whole save file: the same planet, on any device, pinned by literal-value tests. The ground streams in as a quadtree of patches built in workers, with rivers, towns, weather, moons and seasons derived from the same numbers, and custom shaders for clouds, sea, lava and ice. Strict TypeScript, lint-enforced boundaries, 300+ tests.Live appSource

React · TypeScript
IndexedDB · PWA

Client-only · No server

A workout tracker that writes the next session.

Derives each training week from the routine instead of storing it, so editing the plan can never rewrite logged history. Double progression reads your own logged sets to set the next load, with deload weeks built in. IndexedDB behind a repository interface, sync through a backup file in a private GitHub repo, a layered architecture enforced by lint rules, and 350+ tests.Live appSource
